content.title: Masters tee times 2026: Sunday pairings, final round groups, TV schedule
content.text: April 11, 2026Updated April 12, 2026, 10:27 a.m. ETFollow along with live updates of all the final-round action at the Masters Tournament.The championship round of the 2026 Masters Tournament is upon us.After the third round at Augusta National Golf Club, defending champion Rory McIlroy has some competition for the top spot on the leaderboard after Cameron Young climbed from an 8-stroke deficit to tie McIlroy at 11-under to lead the 90th Masters.Young wasn't the only one to scale a comeback. Two-time Masters champion Scottie Scheffler went from 24th place to to a tie for seventh, sitting at 7-under through three rounds. The highlight of Round 3 may have belonged to Ireland's Shane Lowry, who aced a hole-in-one. He enters the final round in fourth place at 9-under. Sam Burns is in third at 10-under.Only 18 holes are left. The final round will crown the 2026 Masters champion, and one golfer will take home the iconic green blazer jacket on Sunday afternoon. McIlroy looks to become the fourth person ever to win back-to-back Masters titles. Young is looking to win his first Masters ever.Here's a look at final-round tee times at the 2026 Masters and how to catch the golf action on Sunday, April 12:Masters Round 4 tee times, pairingsAll times Eastern9:06 a.m.: Aaron Rai and Charl Schwartzel9:17 a.m.: Gary Woodland and Kurt Kitayama9:28 a.m.: Jon Rahm and Sergio Garcia9:39 a.m.: Si Woo Kim and Rasmus Hojgaard9:50 a.m.: Keegan Bradley and Dustin Johnson10:01 a.m.: Matt McCarty and Corey Conners10:12 a.m.: Viktor Hovland and Justin Thomas10:23 a.m.: Alex Noren and Maverick McNealy10:45 a.m.: Adam Scott and Marco Penge10:56 a.m.: Harris English and Samuel Stevens11:07 a.m.: Brian Harmon and Jordan Spieth11:18 a.m.: Sungjae Im and Hideki Matsuyama11:29 a.m.: Sepp Straka and Jacob Bridgeman11:40 a.m.: Chris Gotterup and Kristoffer Reitan11:51 a.m.: Michael Brennan and Max Homa12:13 p.m.: Nick Taylor and Matt Fitzpatrick12:24 p.m.: Ludvig Åberg and Brian Campbell12:35 p.m.: Tyrrell Hatton and Tommy Fleetwood12:46 p.m.: Brooks Koepka and Wyndham Clark12:57 p.m.: Ryan Gerard and Xander Schauffele1:08 p.m.: Jake Knapp and Ben Griffin1:30 p.m.: Patrick Reed and Collin Morikawa1:41 p.m.: Patrick Cantlay and Russell Henley1:52 p.m.: Scottie Scheffler and Haotong Li2:03 p.m.: Jason Day and Justin Rose2:14 p.m.: Sam Burns and Shane Lowry2:25 p.m.: Cameron Young and Rory McIlroyMasters Leaderboard 2026Here's an updated look at the leaderboard for the 2026 Masters Tournament following Saturday's third round at Augusta National:T1.
